title: Deny by Default
description:
Guestbook was reachable from every namespace on the cluster. That was fine for a pilot. It is not fine now.

Write NetworkPolicies that deny by default and allow only the clients the brief names. Unrelated namespaces must stay locked out.

**Meant for:** NetworkPolicies.

problemStatement.brief: Lock the namespace so only allowed clients reach Guestbook; unrelated namespaces stay blocked.
